title: fix(cli): i18n coverage merges a locale's bundles with the runtime's deep merge
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X4KnGd8gzFybTEt5Jco7Z83)_

Fixes #27087

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`os lint` / `os i18n check` 的翻译覆盖检查，把同一语言的多个翻译包合并时，改为直接调用运行时自己的深合并（`@objectstack/core` 的 `deepMerge`）。多包应用（每个包各带一份翻译）不再被误报成百上千条 `i18n/missing-*`。
- **为什么改**：运行时按语言把所有包的翻译深合并后下发，用户看到的是完整翻译；lint 却用自己的一套浅合并，后一个包里的仪表盘、数据集、页面、流程、报表、选项列表翻译全部丢掉，后一个包的 `apps.APP` 还会整条覆盖前一个包的导航标签。HotCRM 拆包后 `os lint --strict` 因此报了 330 条假警告。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只改 lint 的读法，运行时与元数据契约不动；单包应用读到的结果不变。lint 现在读到的恰是运行时下发的那棵树，不会比运行时更宽松。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts`（`mergeTranslationBundles`，替换掉原 `mergeData`/`flattenBundles`）；`packages/cli/test/i18n-multi-bundle-merge.test.ts`（双包验收夹具与运行时对等测试）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/i18n-multi-bundle-merge.test.ts`，预期 20/20 通过；在 `main` 上同一文件 17 条失败，双包夹具报 10 条假缺失。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts` folds a stack's translation bundles per locale with `deepMerge` from `@objectstack/core`, the function the runtime's `loadTranslations` calls. The file's own merge (`mergeData` + `flattenBundles`) is gone; `mergeTranslationBundles` takes its place and is exported from the module (not from the package: `@objectstack/cli`'s `exports` do not reach `src/utils`) so a test can pin it.

| A later bundle carries | Old coverage merge | Runtime and new coverage |
|---|---|---|
| `dashboards`, `datasets`, `pages`, `flows`, `reports`, `picklists`, any other group | dropped | merged key by key |
| `apps.APP` (for example a module restating the app label to ship contributed navigation ids) | replaced the earlier `apps.APP` whole, its navigation included | merged; `navigation` merges per node id |
| `objects.OBJ.fields.FIELD` | replaced the earlier field entry whole | merged key by key |
| `objects`, `globalActions`, `messages`, `metadataForms` (the groups the old merge did fold) | folded one or two levels deep | merged at every depth |
| the same string leaf | last write wins | last write wins |
| an array | replaced | replaced |

- **Reuse, not a third copy.** `@objectstack/core` already exports `deepMerge` from its main entry (`fallbacks/index.ts`, re-exported by `src/index.ts`), and `@objectstack/cli` already depends on `@objectstack/core`. No core change and no new dependency. `service-i18n`'s byte-identical copy is not folded here (outside the claimed file surface); see Acceptance notes.
- **Navigation per id.** `apps.APP.navigation` is `z.record(nodeId, { label })` in `TranslationDataSchema` (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`), and HotCRM authors it that way (`src/sales/translations/zh-CN/app.ts`, "Keyed by navigation-node `id`"). A map merges per id under `deepMerge`, so nothing beyond the reuse was needed, and the runtime does not drop any package's navigation labels.
- **Never more generous than the runtime.** The lint reads the merged tree `GET /api/v1/i18n/translations/LOCALE` serves from the same inputs. The parity test compares the two directly.

## Why

Card #27087 (triage `6461055338`): "One merge rule: coverage reuses the runtime's per-locale deep merge (`service-i18n`), with `apps.APP.navigation` merged per id. No second merger." The runtime path was measured on this base (`a27f889a`): `AppPlugin.loadTranslations` (`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`) calls `i18nService.loadTranslations(locale, data)` for every bundle in order, and both providers fold with `deepMerge`, core's in `createMemoryI18n` and a byte-identical copy in `FileI18nAdapter`.

## Tests

New `packages/cli/test/i18n-multi-bundle-merge.test.ts`, 20 cases:

- **Fixture (the card's shape).** An app package and a module that contributes a navigation item into the app's group, each built with `defineStack`, each carrying its own zh-CN bundle for exactly the keys the walker expects of that package alone (dashboards, datasets, pages, flows, reports, objects, navigation). They are composed module-first with `manifest: 'preserve'` and read through `authoringRuleUnionStack`, as both `os lint` and `os i18n check` do. Two cases pin that the fixture is not vacuous.
- **Acceptance 1.** Clean when both packages translate everything; deleting one key in either bundle gives exactly that one `i18n/missing-*` key. That is 12 cases (6 families × 2 owners) plus one for the app's own navigation label while the module restates the app.
- **Acceptance 2 (parity).** `mergeTranslationBundles(bundles).merged` equals what `createMemoryI18n()` serves after `loadTranslations` of the same bundles in order (`getTranslations(locale)`). This is checked on the fixture's two bundles and on a hand-built pair that overlaps at every depth (objects/fields, apps/navigation, picklists/options, dashboards/widgets, messages, plus a third locale).
- **Controls.** A single-bundle stack is clean, and one deleted key gives exactly that key. A later bundle still overrides an earlier leaf.

<details><summary>Red on the base merge, green on this head</summary>

Red leg: the base blob of `i18n-coverage.ts` (`b2bf5fd9`, `git show a27f889a:…`) written over the committed fix, the test run, then `git checkout HEAD -- …` restored. Restored blob `42fb1d66` equals HEAD's, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

```
base merge:  Tests  17 failed | 3 passed (20)   (VERDICT command-exit 1)
  reports nothing when each package translates everything it owns:
  expected [ …(10) ] to deeply equal []
    apps.mba_desk.navigation.nav_cases.label      ← the module's contributed id, dropped by the app's apps.APP
    dashboards.mba_board.label, dashboards.mba_board.widgets.mba_won.title,
    datasets.mba_metrics.label, …dimensions.stage.label, …measures.total.label,
    reports.mba_summary.label, pages.mba_home.label,
    flows.mba_wizard.label, flows.mba_wizard.screens.mba_step.title   ← the later bundle's groups, dropped
this head:   Tests  20 passed (20)               (VERDICT command-exit 0)
```

The 3 cases green on base are the two fixture-shape pins and the single-bundle control. The parity cases are red on base because the export does not exist there.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `@objectstack/service-i18n` keeps its own `deepMerge` (`file-i18n-adapter.ts`), byte-identical to core's today. It is not folded onto core's here: the claim's file surface is `cli` (plus one core export line if needed, and none was). The parity test pins the lint to core's copy and to the in-memory provider. A future edit to only one of the two copies would let `FileI18nAdapter` serve a different tree from what the lint reads. Observation only, carrier: none.
- `check:i18n-coverage` (the declared-surface ratchet over 14 configs, run on this head after a full build) holds its baseline unchanged: "OK (14 config(s), 527 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)". No in-repo example carries a second bundle in a group the old merge dropped.
- `Clause-②: no`, measured: no accepted input changes and no door refuses anything new. The only way the new merge can report a key the old one did not is a later bundle that writes a non-object over an earlier object, for example `fields: null`. The runtime serves that replacement too, and `TranslationDataSchema` refuses it.

## Verification

All at head `2440ea15`.

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cli^...' build`: VERDICT command-exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build`: 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2` in `packages/cli`: Test Files 344 passed (344), Tests 4978 passed (4978), VERDICT command-exit 0. The `integration` tier is declared to CI; the diff touches no spawn entry or integration file.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` (root config) on the two touched source files: exit 0.
- `pnpm build` (full, so the dist-reading gates can measure): VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates: 61 of 61 exit 0, reconciled</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 61 commands for the 3 changed paths. All were run. `--ran` reconciliation: "61 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Three exited 3 on the first sweep (prerequisites, not findings) and were re-run to 0:
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` after `git fetch --depth=1` of its pinned fixture commit.
- `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` and `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` after the full build ("112 published require entry point(s) across 69 package(s) load").

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (Not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (scoped to the touched files; the repo-wide run is CI's).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
